correctness.rationale: Transpose orbits are n diagonal singleton edges plus n(n-1)/2 pairs, equivalently loops and undirected edges with n forbidden incident stars. The fixed orbit complex D_n has n minimal nonfaces T_i. Alexander dual nerve of complements of the T_i has all proper intersections nonempty and total intersection empty because each T_i contains unique loop, hence dual sphere S^{n-2}, giving integral homology of D_n in dimension C(n,2)-1. D_n is simply connected for n>=4 because all triples are faces; n=3 missing triangle boundaries fill via a different loop. Hurewicz/Whitehead upgrades homology to homotopy sphere, n=2 directly S0. For ambient X_n, natural Alexander dual of row-column forbidden stars and its 2-factor boundary join yields full group action: multiplying nerve degree by ambient-edge permutation sign gives chi((sigma,tau)s^e)=sgn(sigma)^(n+1) sgn(tau)^(n+1) (-1)^{e(n-1)(n+2)/2}. Rational transfer then gives quotient top iff n=1 mod4. Independent mod2 fixed complexes n=2,3,4 gave sole Betti dimensions 0,2,5 and exact signed Lefschetz for five representative elements each n, 15 trace checks.

Neither of these results determines the geometric fixed space for swapping the bipartition nor the sign of its integral top orientation, which is required for full G representation/quotient. Published equivariant balanced bipartite Morse results concern oriented vertex-edge incidence forests, a different simplicial complex and drastically different homology rank.
